caption:
An unexpected equipment failure creates real time pressure, but it doesn't have to mean draining cash reserves you need elsewhere, equipment finance can fund a replacement quickly, spreading the cost over time instead.

The key is moving decisively once you've weighed repair against replacement, rather than letting downtime drag on while you decide.
